column2: This is Lumi Island. A tiny home at the top of your screen, and a little friend who lives in it.
Click it for your PC at a glance. Move away, and it tucks itself back in. When Lumi has nothing to say, it just peeks.
Play some music, and the island shows it. Lumi even dances along. Scroll on the island for volume, or click for the player.
Need to concentrate? Start a focus session. Lumi keeps the time, suggests a break, and celebrates your streaks.
Press Windows, Alt and Space for the command bar. Search your apps, start a focus session, or just ask Lumi.
Lumi can do things for you, and it shows every step. You always see what it did, as it happens.
Changed your mind? Press Stop, or Escape, and Lumi stops right there.
Or just talk. The ring follows your voice, and Lumi's mouth moves with its own.
Lumi has a personality, too. Tap it, pet it, give it a squish. Just don't shake it too hard.
Choose Lumi's colour, how lively it is, and which AI it uses. Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, or a model on your own PC.
Lumi Island. Small, helpful, and always just there.
